title: Does AI and Human Advice Mitigate Punishment for Selfish Behavior? An Experiment on AI ethics From a Psychological Perspective
reasoning: The paper is an experimental study on AI ethics, specifically investigating moral judgment, responsibility attribution, and costly punishment in the context of human-AI interaction. It explicitly uses ethical and moral frameworks (e.g., attribution theory, moral agency) to evaluate how people perceive and punish behavior following AI advice.
